title: 霁华楼 Jihua Lou
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 5.95 m, ridge 8.79 m above the ground

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 紫碧山房
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜後垣西北為紫碧山房前宇為横雲堂山房東巖洞中為石帆室東南為豐樂軒北為霽華樓迤東為景暉樓横雲堂西池上為澄素樓西北為引溪亭（圎圓明園册）臣等謹按紫碧山房額有二其一恭懸正宇内一懸穿堂門檐與引溪亭額皆世宗御書紫碧山房正宇檐額曰樂在人和及横雲堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: North-west beyond the rear wall of 鴻慈永祜: 紫碧山房 with 横雲堂, the cave room 石帆室, 豐樂軒, 霽華樓, 景暉樓, 澄素樓 on the pond and 引溪亭.

evidence.title: 丰乐轩 in 紫碧山房
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鴻慈永祜後垣西北為紫碧山房前宇為横雲堂山房東巖洞中為石帆室東南為豐樂軒北為霽華樓
evidence.summary: S05 puts 丰乐轩 south-east of 石帆室 in 紫碧山房.: S01 labels it in YM22.

evidence.title: 霁华楼: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 初収宿雨霁华披，近远峰峦濯翠姿。却似高楼解著语，壁间宜有喜晴诗。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 霁华楼, 1761. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 霁华楼: 乾隆二十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十七年 (1762), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 傍晩快晴定，山楼登霁华。鱼鳞消薄霭，鸦背爓轻霞。稍释愁霖叹，敢言即景嘉。浃旬希例此，庶慰上农家。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 霁华楼, 1762, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 霁华楼
evidence.locator: v3 p.123, under 紫碧山房; source ref 8-585
evidence.excerpt_zh: 傍晚快晴定，山楼登霁华。鱼鳞消薄霭，鸦背焰轻霞。稍释愁霖叹，敢言即景嘉。浃旬希例此，庶慰上农家。
evidence.summary: Poem 霁华楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1762, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 霁华楼: 乾隆五十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十六年 (1791), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 春园桃李未芳菲，堤柳盆梅露意微。舒迭恰欣逢霁景，物华天宝运神机。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 霁华楼, 1791, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 题霁华楼
evidence.locator: v3 p.122, under 紫碧山房; source ref 8-450
evidence.excerpt_zh: 初收宿雨霁华披，近远峰峦濯翠姿。却似高楼解著语，壁间宜有喜晴诗。
evidence.summary: Poem 题霁华楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1761, filed by the editors under 紫碧山房.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 霁华楼
evidence.locator: from p.199, under 紫碧山房
evidence.summary: 霁华楼: 6 dated items, 1761-1791, of which 6 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1761, last dated 1791.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
